WITH CustomerTotal AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption2013
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
SegmentMin AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption2013) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerTotal
    GROUP BY Segment
),
AnnualAvg AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.Segment,
        SUM(ct.TotalConsumption2013) / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM CustomerTotal ct
    JOIN SegmentMin sm ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment AND ct.TotalConsumption2013 = sm.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
